frozen_before: any bar for October 2024 - September 2025 was fetched; the out-of-sample events and returns do not exist yet
origin: descriptive in-sample finding of the October 13 drift test (docs/investigations/init7-liquid-drift-2026-10-13.md): long up movers at open/20 trail the benchmark by -1.76% net (6-10% movers -5.1%). Found in-sample on October 2025 - September 2026, so it is tested here on the prior, disjoint year only.
purpose: Decide whether shorting liquid after-hours up movers for 20 sessions is a tradable edge. If not, Initiative 7 has no candidate left.
window: events dated 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 (disjoint from the in-sample 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30)
data: same pipeline as the October 13 census: scripts/init7-liquid-ah-census.py --first 2024-10-01 --last 2025-09-30 --bars-only (point-in-time top 1000 by trailing three-month SIP dollar volume from the 2026-10-12 universe including delisted names; daily raw and split-adjusted SIP bars; 16:00-16:59 ET 5-minute SIP bars). Events come from candidates() unchanged (move >= +3% by 16:55 ET with the census volume spike).
rule: short every up mover (move >= +3%) at the split-adjusted official open of D+1, cover at the split-adjusted official close of D+20 (D+1 is session 1)
events: drop events flagged split D->D+1 and events whose symbol lacks split-adjusted bars on the entry or exit day; count drops
benchmark: equal-weight mean of the same open(D+1)-to-close(D+20) return over the point-in-time top 1000 members for D's month that have split-adjusted bars on both days
unit: -(event return - benchmark return) - 10 bps round trip; borrow cost ignored (liquid names), stated as a limit

statistics.cells: one (short, open entry, 20 sessions); no multiple-comparison correction
statistics.interval: bootstrap resampling calendar months of D with replacement, 4000 draws, seed 13; two-sided 95% interval
statistics.pass: mean > 0 AND interval lower bound > 0 AND both chronological halves (split by D at the median event) have mean > 0, at base cost; report +20 bps stress, raw event and benchmark returns too

descriptive_only: move-size buckets (3-6%, 6-10%, >10%); the other seven drift cells on this window; events per month. None can rescue a failed pass.
decision_if_pass: freeze an executable variant (short at the open, 20-session hold, equal size, borrow check) and run it as a shadow ledger on new events; propose to Juan through the daily email before any live change (core strategy/universe change)
decision_if_fail: report that Initiative 7 has no candidate left on liquid names and pick the next lever by the North Star
